card.line: Beth-barah was a landmark near the Jordan, the point to which Ephraim's men seized the waters to block the fleeing Midianites after Gideon's victory. Its exact spot is unknown.

moments.title: Ephraim seizes the Jordan
moments.text: Gideon sent messengers to the hill country of Ephraim to call the men down. They captured the waters of the Jordan as far as Beth-barah, ahead of the Midianites.

problems.problem: The line still definitively places Beth-barah on the Jordan’s waters, although its location is uncertain.
